criteria.notes: The v2 package presents a multi-building campus, building-focused actions, global destinations, continuous cross-level guidance, a route-relevant 2D atlas, and an aligned exploded 3D overview.

Site geometry, three distinct buildings, aligned Library floors, exterior paths, entry portals, vertical connectors, destination metadata, and authored presentation settings all come from the public v2 fixture.
The site map, destination-first directory, building card, atlas cards, collapsed building masses, expanded floor stack, and route-segment emphasis form a purpose-built campus wayfinding experience.
Site and building labels, search controls, cards, route steps, distance summary, and scene controls remain readable at 1920x1080 and 1366x768 without clipped critical text.
Light and dark modes retain clear hierarchy, selected-state contrast, destination legibility, route visibility, and distinguishable building surfaces.
Directory groups, building and destination names, floor chips, guidance steps, and compact controls stay bounded with wrapping, truncation, or scrolling where appropriate.
The map remains the dominant surface while the fixed directory supports search and guidance; atlas and exploded scenes use the available canvas without panel or control collisions.
Campus and floor artwork, semantic colors, route styling, origin marker, building massing, floor ghosting, and both themes render coherently from the packaged assets.
Multi-building site navigation, route-relevant atlas composition, and aligned exploded floor stacks are materially distinct from the flat-map and other boilerplate examples.

screenshots.notes: Full-HD default site view is balanced, nonblank, and keeps the campus, grouped directory, building actions, and controls fully visible.
Compact layout preserves map priority, search, filters, grouped results, touch actions, and safe scrolling without horizontal overflow.
Repeated Full-HD scenario confirms stable site camera framing, label placement, selection styling, and directory composition.
Repeated compact scenario confirms stable responsive behavior with no clipped controls, labels, or panel content.
Dark theme maintains readable map labels, active controls, route summaries, search fields, and grouped results.
Legacy flat-map rendering remains intact with spatial cards, markers, route guidance, directory selection, and kiosk controls.
The 2D atlas shows only the site and route-relevant Library floors; cards align consistently and the complete route summary remains usable.
Exploded 3D renders the selected Library as a readable aligned floor stack, keeps unrelated buildings collapsed, emphasizes the active segment, and has no compositor corruption.
The conventional 2D site view clearly presents all campus buildings, outdoor paths and obstacles, origin, selected building, and visitor actions.
